title: Software deliverables and supervisor sign-off
agent_directive: This JSON is the complete task spec. First read docs/prompts/_standards.json once, then load the skills in `skills`. Read only the `spec_sections` of docs/fypms-docs.md (grep the FR id; never open the whole file). Build only what `build` lists and reply with `reply_format` from _standards.json.

models.name: SoftwareDeliverableDocument
models.work: schema, repo, submit + signoff actions, UI

build: src/lib/deliverables/validate.ts (pure): GitHub or GitLab repository URL, optional https demo URL, optional https cloud-storage link, environment_setup_notes up to 20000 characters. Unit-tested.
src/app/actions/submit-deliverable.ts: team member; allowed when team.status is defense_ready or completed; blocked after supervisor sign-off.
src/app/actions/signoff-deliverable.ts: the team's assigned supervisor only; sets approved_by_supervisor_at and supervisor_signoff_notes; writeAudit deliverable.signed_off; notify the team.

/deliverables: student form with a safe markdown preview for setup notes (you may add react-markdown and rehype-sanitize); supervisor list of their teams with open-link buttons and a sign-off dialog; coordinator overview with a sign-off status column; examiners can view submitted links.
assumptions: Submission opens when the team becomes defense_ready so examiners can see links before the defense (FR-07.4)
out_of_scope: Using sign-off as a publish precondition (11-02)
acceptance: Team cannot write sign-off fields; non-assigned supervisor cannot sign off
